item.title: House committee passes bill repealing law establishing University of Alabama’s School of Social Work
item.description: MONTGOMERY — Members of the House Ways and Means Education Committee passed legislation repealing a law establishing the University of Alabama's School of Social Work on Tuesday.The bill by State Rep. Danny Garrett (R-Trussville) would remove the language in state statute that requires the university to continue the program as a standalone college.
